notes: Added remaining stories to complete schema validation, testing, and integration coverage for enforcement.

Add integration tests with MongoDB and GPTReader

change_log.note: Covers security validation from audit requirements

stories.title: Implement Request/Response Contract Validation
stories.description: Define and enforce strict Pydantic schemas for incoming GPTReader requests and outgoing responses to ensure only allowed structures reach the enforcement engine.

stories.title: Unit Test Allowlist Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Create unit tests covering valid queries, invalid field access, operator misuse, limit violations, and malformed payloads to ensure enforcement engine correctness.

stories.title: Integration Test GPTReader Enforcement Path
stories.description: Extend integration tests to verify that all GPTReader requests pass through enforcement before MongoDB execution, including both allowed and rejected scenarios.

stories.title: Security SIT: Allowlist Bypass Attempts
stories.description: Develop SIT scenarios simulating adversarial inputs (injection, over-broad queries, hidden operators) to validate that enforcement blocks all non-allowlisted access patterns.
